highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Missouri State University (MSU) is a public university in Springfield, Missouri, United States. It is the state's second-largest university by enrolment, and is deeply rooted in public affairs and civic leadership.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At MSU, you’ll be part of a friendly community with more than 375 student organisations. The Student Activities Council curates entertaining events, like comedy shows, concerts, and movie nights.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
MSU offers a range of modern and comfortable accommodation options on campus. You can choose from 10 residence halls, including shared rooms and suite-style living options.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Meyer Library is your campus study hub, packed with books, magazines, study rooms, and computer labs.

Sports
The Foster Recreation Centre is packed with amenities: a recreational pool, cardio and weight areas, rock-climbing, an indoor jogging track, basketball courts, and dance studios. MSU also runs Outdoor Adventures, lending equipment like tents and canoes.

Laboratory
You’ll also find multiple lab facilities, including specialised engineering laboratories, health and medical labs, computing labs, and more.

Cafeteria
You’ll find three dining centres on campus. Blair-Shannon Dining Centre, located in Blair-Shannon House, and Heitz Dining Centre, located in Heitz House, are all-you-can-eat dining centres.
